79238-with-the-german-armies-in-the-west.creator: Unknown
79238-with-the-german-armies-in-the-west.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. introduced into my narrative any harsh and condemnatory utterances regarding Germany’s conduct of the war. The fact is that I have had no occasion for such utterances. My self-imposed task was, as I have repeatedly made clear, merely to describe what I saw with my own eyes and as much as possible to refrain from citing the experience of others.

arxiv-2506-11479.title: A stochastic Galerkin method for optimal Dirichlet boundary control problems with uncertain data
arxiv-2506-11479.creator: Max Winkler, Hamdullah Yücel
arxiv-2506-11479.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Max Winkler, Hamdullah Yücel. The paper deals with a stochastic Galerkin approximation of elliptic Dirichlet boundary control problems with random input data. The expectation of a tracking cost functional with the deterministic constrained control is minimized. Error estimates are derived for the control variable in L 2 ​ ( ∂ 𝒟 ) L^{2}(\partial{\mathcal{D}}) -norm and state variable in L 2 ​ ( Γ , L 2 ​ ( 𝒟 ) ) {L^{2}(\Gamma;L^{2}({\mathcal{D}}))} -norm.

arxiv-2506-18865.title: A Greedy Version of the Frame Algorithm
arxiv-2506-18865.creator: Brody Dylan Johnson
arxiv-2506-18865.description: Abstract . The frame algorithm uses a simple recursive formula to approximate an unknown vector from its frame coefficients. This note introduces an adaptive version of the frame algorithm that maximizes the error reduction between steps in terms of an equivalent norm.

arxiv-2510-22854.title: A powerful goodness-of-fit test using the probability integral transform of order statistics
arxiv-2510-22854.creator: Christian T. Covington, Jeffrey W. Miller
arxiv-2510-22854.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christian T. Covington, Jeffrey W. Miller. Goodness-of-fit (GoF) tests are a fundamental component of statistical practice, essential for checking model assumptions and testing scientific hypotheses. Despite their widespread use, popular GoF tests exhibit surprisingly low statistical power against substantial departures from the null hypothesis.

arxiv-2512-13496.title: Identification of Technical Design Constraints and Considerations for Transmission Grid Expansion Planning Projects
arxiv-2512-13496.creator: Giacomo Bastianel, Clement Hardy, Nils Charels, Dirk Van Hertem, Hakan Ergun
arxiv-2512-13496.description: Abstract The large-scale deployment of renewable energy sources, particularly offshore wind, requires large-scale transmission grid expansion projects to transmit the produced low-carbon power to the main demand centers. However, the planning and design of such complex projects currently lack a transparent and systematic process that system operators can follow when considering such investments in their grids.

pmc-10634220.title: Alcohol and psychoactive substance use in a cohort of children followed by child protection in France
pmc-10634220.creator: Aziz Essadek, Maeva Musso, Adèle Assous, Frédéric Widart, Joris Mathieu, Marion Robin, Gérard Shadili
pmc-10634220.description: Background and aimMany studies have investigated the association between maltreatment and substance use in adulthood.In this study, we sought to explore the association between substance use during adolescence, diverse forms of child maltreatment, and psychological symptoms within a cohort of individuals under the purview of child protection services in France.

pmc-11330510.title: The magnitude of neurocognitive disorders and associated factors among people living with HIV AIDS facilities in Bahir Dar City Ethiopia
pmc-11330510.creator: Meseret Manaye, Ergoye Melese, Gizachew Tadesse Wassie
pmc-11330510.description: Neurocognitive disorders are mental health conditions that are caused by medical illnesses and can lead to several acquired cognitive deficits, which represent a decline from a previously attained level of functioning. The principal domains of cognitive functions include complex attention, executive function, learning and memory, language, perceptual–motor function, and social cognition.

pmc-11356136.title: A Flexible Wearable Strain Sensor Based on Nano-Silver-Modified Laser-Induced Graphene for Monitoring Hand Movements
pmc-11356136.creator: Mian Zhong, Yao Zou, Hongyun Fan, Shichen Li, Yilin Zhao, Bin Li, Bo Li, Yong Jiang, Xiaoqing Xing, Jiaqing Shen, Chao Zhou, Won Gu Lee
pmc-11356136.description: The advancement in performance in the domain of flexible wearable strain sensors has become increasingly significant due to extensive research on laser-induced graphene (LIG). An innovative doping modification technique is required owing to the limited progress achieved by adjusting the laser parameters to enhance the LIG’s performance.

pmc-11459110.title: Implementation and Evaluation of a Home-Based Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis Monitoring Option: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11459110.creator: Chase Cannon, Katherine Holzhauer, Matthew Golden, Amaryllis Mavragani, Steven John, Akshay Sharma
pmc-11459110.description: BackgroundHIV prevention is a public health priority. Despite progress in recent years, pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) use remains suboptimal especially among groups disproportionately impacted by new HIV diagnoses such as gender and sexual minorities of color. Multiple barriers including a lack of PrEP providers and challenges with attending quarterly monitoring visits contribute to low PrEP uptake and retention.

pmc-12645006.title: Fertility knowledge and employment status among Japanese pregnant women: J-PEARL study
pmc-12645006.creator: Kyoko Namimatsu, Jun Takeda, Motoki Endo, Yuito Ueda, Shintaro Makino, Takeshi Tanigawa, Atsuo Itakura
pmc-12645006.description: ObjectiveDespite recent improvements, fertility knowledge among Japanese individuals remains substantially lower than in other countries. This study aimed to evaluate fertility knowledge among women with pregnancy and childbirth experience and assess differences based on employment status, given the increasing intersection of professional careers and reproductive decision making.MethodsA cross-sectional, multicenter questionnaire survey was administered to postpartum women at seven hospitals.

pmc-12689086.title: Efficacy of Topical Manuka Honey for Chronic Rhinosinusitis After Endoscopic Sinus Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12689086.creator: Yun Jin Kang, Min Ju Kang, Sung Won Kim, Soo Hwan Kim, Yong Jin Park
pmc-12689086.description: Background and ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to perform a systematic review and meta-analysis evaluating the efficacy of topical manuka honey in the postoperative management of chronic rhinosinusitis following endoscopic sinus surgery.Methods A systematic search was conducted using PubMed, Embase, OVID, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials.

pmc-12696073.title: Latent profile analysis of potential health-promoting behaviors in patients after esophageal cancer surgery: a multicenter cross-sectional survey
pmc-12696073.creator: Juan Wang, Yuan Yu, Li Liu, Yan Miao, Yue Fu, Yanting Ning, Junli Liang
pmc-12696073.description: ObjectivesThe objectives of this study were to identify potential health-promoting behaviors in patients after esophageal cancer surgery and explore their influencing factors by performing latent profile analysis.MethodsA convenience sampling method was used to select 438 postoperative patients with esophageal cancer from 14 cancer centers across the country as survey participants.

pmc-13041276.title: Exploring the efficacy of new potential bio-insecticides produced by Penicillium oxalicum against Culex pipiens larvae
pmc-13041276.creator: Hayam A E Sayed, Enas H S Ghallab, Ahmed M Elissawy, Peter F Farag, Nevin A Ibrahim
pmc-13041276.description: BackgroundSynthetic insecticides are major contributors to environmental pollution and the emergence of resistance. Fungal-derived metabolites are known to be environmentally friendly, selective alternatives. Thus, in the context of a green environment, this study aimed to evaluate the larvicidal activity of a mangrove-associated endophytic Penicillium oxalicum (OQ231606.1) against Culex pipiens using a larval mortality bioassay and molecular docking.

pmc-13449687.title: Proteomics in bone malignancies: from bulk profiling to single-cell and ultra-low-input technologies
pmc-13449687.creator: Jianming Chen, Jiaqiao Luo, Ning Ni, Jinhao Zhang, Lei Jiang, Hongbao Wu, Shenghao Wen, Ninghao Hu, Jiaran Li, Gang Deng, Shuxiang Song, Xiaomeng Shi
pmc-13449687.description: BackgroundBone malignancies, particularly high-grade primary bone sarcomas, remain clinically challenging due to early dissemination, marked heterogeneity, and limited progress in systemic therapies for metastatic or relapsed disease. While genomics and transcriptomics have clarified structural complexity and transcriptional programs, they provide only an indirect view of the functional machinery that ultimately drives invasion, immune escape, and therapy resistance.

pmc-13465528.title: Estimating the impact and cost-effectiveness of antenatal care approaches in 24 low- and middle-income countries: a modelling study
pmc-13465528.creator: Nisaa Wulan, Debra ten Brink, Tharindu Wickramaarachchi, Sam Ali, Aris T Papageorghiou, Nick Scott
pmc-13465528.description: BackgroundAntenatal care (ANC) is a critical intervention for improving maternal and newborn health outcomes, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). This study modelled the potential impact and cost-effectiveness of a theoretical community-based and risk-stratified model of ANC in LMICs.

uslaw-usc-t25-s4355.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 44A (Native American Tourism And Improving Visitor Experience). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Nothing in this chapter alters, or demonstrates congressional support for the alteration of, the legal relationship between the United States and any American Indian, Alaska Native, or Native Hawaiian individual, group, organization, or entity.
